issue.title: @route^id Go To: open a task by its exact address from Bob Capture
issue.description: A capture draft that is exactly one bare `@route^block-id` token resolves read-only to that block's line and, on Return, opens it in Obsidian through the same `obsidian://bob-goto-task` landing the `/` picker uses. The panel shows the destination before Return, typing `@route^` browses that note's IDs as Go rows, misses are calm did-you-mean states, nothing is ever written, and every other caret form keeps today's meaning byte for byte.
